title: V2 design baseline: orchestrator-resolved decisions for the 400 V -> 200 V, 5 kW, 50 kHz SiC synchronous buck
status: AI-GENERATED ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE V2 - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED; single source of truth for schematic, PCB, simulation and documents; derived from design/research/*.json (ten design areas) and the twenty independent verification reports design/research/verify_*.json; every document, model and calculation must cite these values and record the research record it came from

requirements_user.topology: synchronous buck, non-isolated, common negative rail PGND

assumptions_accepted.load_dump_25A_excursion_V_allowed: must stay below the 230 V output OVP (computed 215-218 V with 120 uF at fc 2.5 kHz)
assumptions_accepted.cooling: forced air over a shared PE-bonded heatsink with rated insulating pads; inductor in the same fan stream
assumptions_accepted.aux_12V: external regulated 12 V +/-10 %; 2.0 A minimum, 2.5 A recommended; fan and relay coil included in the budget
assumptions_accepted.isolation_concept: control electronics are a SELV domain; the single-point SGND-to-PE bond (PELV) is a PROPOSED DEVIATION from the SELV seed that the human reviewer must approve (assumption A-23); every HV crossing uses a reinforced-rated isolator
assumptions_accepted.environment: OVC II, pollution degree 2, <= 2000 m, 5-85 % RH, laboratory/industrial cabinet, instructed persons, DVC C parts behind IPXXB covers

impulse_withstand_basis_V.note: conservative 600 V-system row adopted because the DC source is unspecified; an OVC II 300 V system would allow 2.5 kV (1.5 / 3.0 mm) - recorded conflict for review

assumptions_accepted.pcb_material: FR4 Tg >= 150 C, CTI >= 175 V (group IIIa, Isola 370HR class; CTI class unverified), ENIG
assumptions_accepted.load_type: resistor bank or electronic load CC/CR; no battery, no constant-power below 20 % load without stability review
assumptions_accepted.source: regulated DC bus or current-limited laboratory supply; current limit 18-25 A; controlled ramp; no hot-plug onto a stiff live bus
assumptions_accepted.firmware_power_derating: below 360 V the input current is limited to 15.6 A (the 320 V UVLO-stop corner at 27.5 A would otherwise draw 17.5 A)
corrections_to_seeds: overload peak current evaluated at the 440 V corner with the real choke: 31.6 A nominal / 32.0 A worst (seed 31.3 A)

saturation requirement expressed for the soft-saturating powder core: L(41 A) >= 70 % of L(25 A) and B_dc + B_ac <= 0.8 x B_sat; the vendor-style I_sat (30 % drop from L0) is 37.3 A nominal / ~35 A worst and is reported alongside
0.25 mm track/space preferred on 70 um layers, 0.20 mm only with fabricator confirmation
efficiency floor 97.5 % added under the 98 % target
dead time 250 ns is an agent assumption (not a task default); 300 ns programmed at bring-up

mosfet.rds_on_25C_mohm: 28 typ at V_GS = 15 V (25 typ / 33 max at 18 V; no 15 V maximum published; 37 mohm is a scaled estimate)
mosfet.id_A: 86 at T_C 25 C / 62 at T_C 100 C (specified at V_GS = 18 V)
mosfet.selection_basis: 1200 V class chosen for 42-46 % voltage utilisation including a 62-88 V overshoot allowance (25-35 nH loop at 2.5 A/ns); standing TO-247 leads add 15-25 nH per lead, so the real loop may reach 40-60 nH - the 1200 V margin absorbs it (even 150 V overshoot = 49 %); 650 V C3M0015065K rejected at 77-84 % utilisation; the 900 V C3M0030090K cited by the knowledge base is obsolete; utilisation limits 80/90/70 % are engineering judgement for human review

losses_W_per_pair.400V_25A_150C: 46.7 (HS switching 9.8 W at k_RG 1.3) to 52 (k_RG 2.0) plus ~1 W HS E_oss

mosfet.parasitic_turn_on: charge-based estimate (Q_gd 20-27 nC into C_gs 3.08 nF through the 5.6 ohm off path, 8-13 ns edge) gives 4.5-5.2 V excursion from -4 V -> about +0.5 to +1.2 V versus V_GS(th) min 2.0 V (25 C; hot minimum unpublished): the active Miller clamp is REQUIRED, not optional; off-state V_GS to be measured per PRD-09301 section 6.1
mosfet.fallback: C3M0021120K (same footprint and rails, +8 W; Rev. 4 June 2025 datasheet, check for newer)
open_checks: Wolfspeed Gen-4 750 V TO-247-4 industrial family: existence to be checked; would be the natural class for 440-480 V
C4MS025120K availability: Arrow stock only, 13-week lead (Oct 2026 snippets)
mosfet.tab_potentials: HS tab = VIN+ (DC), LS tab = SW (switching; 2.3 A displacement-current pulses through the pad); both insulated from the PE-bonded heatsink
mosfet.package_dimensions_mm: TO-247-4L (Wolfspeed Rev. 2 table maxima): width E 16.13, height D 23.63, thickness A 5.21; exposed tab D1 x E1 ~ 17.0 x 13.6 (to confirm on the drawing)

gate_driver.package: SOIC-16 DW (7.5 x 10.3 mm body) - KiCad Package_SO:SOIC-16W_7.5x10.3mm_P1.27mm
gate_driver.isolation: 5.7 kVrms, VIORM 2121 Vpk, VIOWM 1500 Vrms / 2121 VDC, > 150 V/ns CMTI, > 8 mm package creepage (SLUSDH8D, fetched)
gate_driver.inputs: IN+ = own PWM, IN- = complementary PWM (cross-wired hardware interlock, KR-GD-009); 100 ohm + 100 pF + 10 k pull-down at each input pin; RST/EN internal pull-down 28.5-113 kohm

rails_V.option_vdd_18V: BOM option for C4MS only (FBVDD top resistor 127 k)
rails_V.why_negative: computed off-state excursion up to +1.2 V from -4 V; 0 V turn-off would leave no margin (KR-GD-005 applied because the synchronous buck is a half bridge)

gate_driver.eon_penalty_W: +1.9 W at 6.8 ohm (k 1.6), +3.8 W at 10 ohm (k 1.9) relative to the MOSFET agent's k 1.3
gate_driver.miller_clamp: REQUIRED: CLMPI to gate through a 0 ohm 0603 link, path <= 15 mm, same Kelvin pour return
gate_driver.gate_kelvin_rc_dnp: 0603 pads for 1 ohm + 470 pF, DNP (KR-GD-010 review)
gate_driver.decoupling: 2 x 4.7 uF + 100 nF (VDD-COM), 1 x 4.7 uF + 100 nF (COM-VEE) between the driver output pins and the gate/Kelvin connection (C_eff >= 1.25 uF for 100 mV droop; COM-VEE droop ~41 mV)

desat.diode: US1M-13-F (1000 V, SMA), cathode to drain, one per channel (lifecycle unverified)
desat.network: VDD -> 2.2 k -> node A -> diode; node A -> 4.99 k -> OC; OC -> 1.00 k -> COM; 680 pF C0G OC-COM; Schottky clamp COM->OC as a reference-derived DNP option (the -0.67 V DC case does not occur dynamically)
desat.withstand_note: Wolfspeed publishes no short-circuit withstand time for C4MS025120K; PRD-08296 (separate Wolfspeed note, module data) and forum statements of 2-3 us are not datasheet values; destructive short-circuit test required (KR-PR-001 hard constraint, verification by test)

gate_driver.fault_signals: FLT_N (open drain, latched) and RDY (open drain, parallelable) per driver; RST_EN from GPIO (low >= 1 us clears)
gate_driver.ain_apwm: AIN tied to COM on both drivers (unused; datasheet pin table); APWM not connected; see conflict_resolutions CR-01
gate_driver.vgs_probe: 2-pin probe loop at the device side of R_G on each driver island (HV referenced, isolated probe only)

bias_supply.package: 36-pin DWN wide SOIC (custom footprint from TI drawing; no KiCad library part)
bias_supply.isolation: VISO 5000 Vrms, VIORM 1414 Vpk, VIOWM 1414 VDC (reinforced), CIO < 3.5 pF (not legible in the extraction; 5 pF upper bound used for i_CM = 0.72 A), > 8 mm; certifications were 'planned' in SLUSF10B (June 2023) - status to confirm
bias_supply.ratings: 1.5 W output for VIN 10.8-13.2 V at TA <= 85 C; 1.0 W for 8-18 V; absolute maximum POUT_VDD 2.5 W (25 C); SOA curve at 19 V / 10.8 V / board ambient still to be read
bias_supply.gate_channels: VDD-VEE 19.0 V (107 k / 16.2 k 0.1 %), COM-VEE 4.0 V (9.76 k / 16.2 k 0.1 %), 330 pF C0G across each bottom resistor; RLIM per datasheet procedure (human review)
bias_supply.sensing_channel: VDD-VEE 15.0 V, COM-VEE 5.0 V (16.2 k / 16.2 k); VEE = PGND; COM = 5V_ISO feeds the two AMC1311 VDD1 pins directly (sourcing direction of the COM regulator, no LDO); load ~20 mA; see CR-12
bias_supply.input: 12V_PROT through Wuerth 744226S CM choke, 3 x 10 uF 25 V X7R 1210 (>= 20 uF effective at 13.2 V) between choke and VIN pin, 100 nF at VIN; ENA = BIAS_EN; PG (active low) to the fault combiner
bias_supply.output_caps: 2 x 4.7 uF (VDD-VEE) + 4.7 uF (COM-VEE) at the module

power_budget_W.kr_is_001_conflict: Wolfspeed form Q_G f_sw dV = 0.119 W per device; TI TIDA-010054 Eq. 30 form (factor 2) = 0.24 W - both shown, budget uses the larger

inductor.type: custom toroidal choke (no orderable standard part exists for 220-300 uH at 25-32 A; 13 families searched)
inductor.core: 2 x Magnetics 0058192A2 High Flux 60u, stacked (OD 58.0 mm, HT 16.1 mm each); catalogue selector lists the size as C058192A2 - orderable code to confirm
inductor.wire: AWG 10 heavy build (alt 2 x AWG 13 bifilar); ~26 turns in the first inner-diameter layer, ~8 in the second
inductor.temperature: average surface rise 50-55 K typical / 62-69 K bounded in still air; hot spot 110-120 C with the +10-15 K internal allowance -> forced air over the inductor is REQUIRED (placed in the fan stream) or the 3-stack fallback; acceptance thermocouple at the inner-diameter winding, <= 110 C
inductor.envelope: wound OD ~65-69 mm, height 40-43 mm; potted in a UL94 V-0 cup ~72 x 46 mm; keep-out circle 75 mm, height 48 mm
inductor.mounting: cup bolted to 4 x M4 standoffs on a 60 x 60 mm pattern; mass never carried by solder joints
inductor.pcb_footprint: 2 x PTH 3.2 mm finished hole, 6.0 mm pads on all layers, pitch 25.4 mm; 4 x 4.3 mm NPTH on 60 x 60 mm with 8 mm copper-free annulus; terminals >= 4 mm from other nets
inductor.emi_handoff: winding end-to-end capacitance / SRF and displacement current under the 110-120 V/ns SW dv/dt to be estimated; SW-side turns and lead kept away from the TMCS1133 path

input_film.footprint: custom 4-pad: (+/-18.75, +/-5.10) mm, drill 1.6 mm, pad 3.0 mm, courtyard 28 x 42 mm, height 37 mm

input_hf_ceramic.placement: row 1 within 5 mm and row 2 within 15 mm of the HS drain / LS source pins, both sides of the device row
input_hf_ceramic.alternate: Knowles 2220Y1K00474KXTWS2 (1 kV; StackiCap height to verify)
input_hf_ceramic.dc_bias_note: 60 % loss at 440 V assumed; TDK curve not fetched (open issue)
input_hf_ceramic.ring_current: film-to-ceramic resonance ~670 kHz launched at every edge: ~1.1 W in the loop resistance (0.75-1.5 W for 20-40 nH), 0.75-1.4 A rms per MLCC - thermally tolerable, stated

capacitors.damping_leg_dnp: 1 uF 630 V film + 0.47 ohm >= 2 W (two 1 W 2512 in parallel) across the HF tier, DNP until the extracted loop inductance is known

output_film.footprint: custom 4-pad: (+/-18.75, +/-10.15) mm, drill 1.6 mm, pad 3.0 mm, courtyard 30 x 45 mm, height 45 mm

bleeders.input: 3 x Vishay CRCW2512120KFKEG in series (360 k, 0.54 W at 440 V, 160 V per element at 480 V) plus indicator chain 3 x 150 k 1206 + red LED (DC-LINK LIVE; <= 160 V and 0.17 W per element)
bleeders.output: 2 x Vishay CRCW2512100KFKEG in series (200 k, 0.20 W; 0.97 W / 220 V per element under a high-side-short fault at 440 V) plus indicator chain 2 x 100 k 1206 + red LED
bleeders.criterion: < 60 V within 60 s with IEC 60417-5036 label; the compliant 5 s passive alternative costs about 4.5 W (60 k input / 32 k output) and is documented as the preferred option if the integrator demands 5 s

capacitors.snubber_dnp: RC pads across the LS device (SW-PGND): 2512 resistor + 1812 1 kV capacitor, DNP until double-pulse results
capacitors.mov_optional: TDK S20K385 = B72220S0381K101 (8 kA, 150 J, 1.0 W) across VIN+/PGND, DNP

current.placement: inductor output path (L1 -> TMCS1133 -> VOUT bus)
current.isolation: 950 Vrms / 1343 VDC reinforced, >= 8 mm (SBOSAG0E; TI product page shows 600 Vrms / 8.1 mm - datasheet governs, confirm with TI)
current.conductor: 0.7 mohm, 0.53 W at 27.5 A; 80 Arms rating is at 25 C (44 Arms at 125 C)
current.oc_setting: VOC = 0.750 V from a REF3125 2.5 V via 2.32 k / 1.00 k on the power-board SELV strip
current.overload_margin: 32.0 A worst overload peak vs 33.7 A worst-case low trip bound (1.7 A before sensor error)
current.trip_overshoot_worst: with L 175 uH: di/dt 2.5 A/us at 440 V, 1.4 A overshoot, worst peak ~42.6 A (soft roll-off core, CR-05)
current.footprint: custom DVG-16 with fused bar pads for IN+/IN- (25 A) and 8 individual SELV pins (TI drawing)

vin.ladder: 4 x 750 k 1206 0.1 % + 10.0 k, 1 nF across bottom + 100 pF at IN (TIDA ratio reused after recomputation)
vin.conversion: OPA2320 difference amplifier gain 1.5, 32 kHz filter, on the power-board SELV strip; single-ended VIN_SENSE over the mezzanine; 1 k + 1 nF at ADCINA0

vout.conversion: OPA2320 gain 1.5 on the power-board SELV strip; VOUT_SENSE to ADCINB1

sensing.sensing_island_supply: dedicated third UCC14141-Q1 (CR-12): 5V_ISO = COM-VEE 5.0 V, VEE = PGND; AMC1311 GND1 = PGND; the TIDA-010054 pattern (TLV76050 from the LS gate VDD, RLIM review, 25.1 mA / 0.38 W, R_pre <= 289 ohm) remains the documented alternative

heatsink_temperature.part: Vishay NTCALUG01A103F (10 k +/-1 %, B25/85 3984 K, lug NTC; Vishay doc 29092 rev 14-Jan-2026: -55 to +150 C, 13 mW/K, thermal time constant 5 s, 1500 Vac / 100 Mohm lug-to-terminal insulation, AEC-Q200; -161 variant with 160 mm leads if the route to the control board needs it)
heatsink_temperature.mounting: M3 thread-forming hole on the sink top face beside the HS device footprint (there is no bare aluminium between the bodies at 28 mm pitch); spreading offset +4-6 K
heatsink_temperature.route: two-wire lead to J_NTC on the control board; 2.2 k pull-up to 3.00 V (REF3125 buffered) + 100 nF; ADCINA2
heatsink_temperature.tj_mapping: T_J,HS ~ T_NTC + 4-6 K spreading + P_HS x (R_pad + R_thJC) ~ T_NTC + 50-66 K at full load (1.4 K/W pad; up to 66 K with max-R parts) (KR-TH-003: cooling supervision, not junction protection; thresholds are human-review proposals)

sensing.adc_front_end: 1 k + 1 nF at every ADC pin (F28335 analog pins clamp a diode above VDDA2 with +/-2 mA; 0-3 V is the conversion range, not an absolute maximum)

fast_hardware: DESAT per switch (UCC21710, 0.55-1.07 us; the only protection against shoot-through)
TMCS1133 OC 37.5 A -> latch -> RST_EN + TZ1, and OC_N -> TZ2 directly (inductor-current faults)

comparators.ovp_out_divider: 953 ohm / 10.0 k on the 0.0099338 V/V output sense (229.8 V)
comparators.uvlo_note: non-latched run permit with auto-restart and soft start; open-collector hysteresis network is asymmetric - verify by simulation or implement bus UVLO in firmware
comparators.otp_note: ratiometric to the 3.00 V NTC pull-up reference

protection.fault_latch: SN74LVC1G74DCTR (SSOP-8; the DCKR suffix does not exist): D = 1, CLK = ARM (GPIO2), CLR_N = combined latched fault; Q = ARMED = FAULT_N to TZ1 (GPIO12) and to the PWM AND gates
protection.fault_combiner: 2 x SN74LV21A AND gates (tpd max 12 ns at 3.3 V). LATCHED group -> CLR_N: FLT_H_N, FLT_L_N, OC_N, OVP_IN_N, OVP_OUT_N, OTP_N, FLT_12V_N, XRS_N, ESTOP_N, DSP_TRIP_N, PG_BIAS_H_N, PG_BIAS_L_N, PG_BIAS_S_N. RUN-PERMIT group (not latched) -> PWM enable: UVLO_N, RDY_H, RDY_L, ARMED
protection.pwm_gating: ePWM1A/1B -> SN74LVC2G08 (PWM AND ARMED AND RUN_PERMIT) -> 33 ohm -> mezzanine -> 100 ohm + 100 pF + 10 k at each UCC21710 input; 10 k pull-downs on PWM_H, PWM_L and ARM at the gate/latch inputs; pull-ups on DSP_TRIP_N and ESTOP_N (F28335 GPIO0-11 have no reset pull-ups)
protection.restart_policy: operator reset only after a DESAT/OC fault (one attempt maximum); UVLO auto-restart with soft start; OTP auto after cool-down optional

power_path.fuse: Littelfuse KLKD025.T 25 A 600 V DC fast-acting midget in a 10 x 38 mm holder on the input lead (off-board); 57 % loading at 360 V / 25 A, 70 % at the 320 V stop corner with 27.5 A; 50 kA at 600 VDC interrupting (product page); melting I2t to be obtained; with a <= 20 A current-limited source the fuse never opens - protection then rests on the source limit, the OC/UVLO logic and the 4.3 J stored energy
power_path.precharge: PTC thermistor on-board across two HV relay-contact terminals (TDK B59xxx to be re-selected from the current datasheet: R25 100-150 ohm, Vmax >= 480 V DC, Vlink >= 620 V DC; the B59773C0120A070 code quoted by the sensing agent does not carry the quoted parameters) + Omron G9EA-1 DC12 bypass relay (60 A carry, maximum switching voltage 400 V) chassis-mounted; close when V_bus > 340 V and dV/dt < 2 V per 10 ms (500 ms timeout -> PRECHARGE_FAIL); the relay is NEVER commanded open under load (sequencing: open >= 10 ms after PWM stop and only after the source is off); coil-to-contact insulation to be shown reinforced for 440 V DC or the coil placed behind protective separation (human review)
power_path.precharge_numbers: tau 5.8 ms (4.4-7.3), t99 27 ms (20-34), E 4.7-5.6 J, PTC dT 2.7 K (with 48.7 uF effective)
power_path.relay_coil_drive: AO3400A low-side switch (RDS(on) 48 mohm max at 2.5 V) + >= 1 A freewheel diode (e.g. SS14) on the power-board SELV strip; coil 417 mA at 12 V; firmware PWM hold at ~50-60 % after pull-in is REQUIRED for the 12 V budget
power_path.pe: M4 PE stud bonded to heatsink and baseplate (PE conductor >= supply conductor cross-section, bond <= 0.1 ohm); SGND to PE single-point link (proposed deviation A-23); PGND-to-PE configurable link footprint + 2 x 1 M 500 V reference resistors + optional Y2 10 nF footprints (DNP until the source earthing is defined)

controller.dsp: TMS320F28335PGFA, all 176 pins mapped (components/tms320f28335_pgf_pins.csv); 30 MHz oscillator on XCLKIN; 14-pin JTAG; 3.3 V UART; boot straps GPIO84-87; V1 patterns reused
controller.supplies: 12V_PROT -> TPS54302DDCR (5 V) -> TPS767D301PWPR (1.9 V adj 18.2 k / 30.1 k, 3.3 V fixed, core-first sequencing; EP variant NRND, TLV752 named alternative) ; TPS3808G01 5 V supervisor with 101 k / 10 k for a 4.5 V threshold (105 k would trip at 4.66 V); I_5V 0.54 A; P_LDO 1.39 W

aux_12V_protection.mode: open = circuit breaker with 4 ms timeout and 540 ms auto-retry
aux_12V_protection.margin_to_i_cb: 1.11x during relay pull-in, 1.23x steady - external supply 2.5 A recommended; fan upstream of the eFuse is the fallback if margin proves insufficient

interconnect.type: stacked mezzanine, 2 x 25 pins, 2.54 mm; socket Samtec SSW-125-01-G-D on the power-board SELV strip, header Samtec TSW-125-07-G-D on the control board (alt Wuerth WR-PHD); four M3 standoffs; mated height about 11.05 mm (SSW insulator 8.51 mm + TSW insulator 2.54 mm, Samtec catalog; drawing to confirm before fixing standoff length); 6.3 A per pin, 500 VAC rating; 24 ground pins
interconnect.signalling: buffered single-ended with 100 ohm / 100 pF / 10 k at each receiving pin (KR-GD-008 exclusion for short on-board links, applied by adaptation to the mezzanine); RS-422 only if a cable > 150 mm is ever used
power_board_selv_strip_also_carries: driver input RC networks and pull-downs
bias-module CM chokes and input capacitors (3 modules)
OPA2320 difference amplifiers, REF3125 and the TMCS1133 V_OC divider, 3V3 decoupling
4 x M3 standoff holes for the control board
control_board_connectors: J_12V 2-pin 5.08 mm terminal block (12 V in)

architecture.option: B: separate power PCB and DSP control PCB; drivers, bias modules and all isolators stay on the power board; the control board is entirely SELV

power_board.zones: HV area 240 x 140 mm = 33,600 mm2 (73 % utilisation with the research envelopes, ~90 % with the heatsink strip), ISO_BARRIER 10 mm copper-free on all layers, SELV strip 30 mm along the bottom edge; the 230 x 170 mm stretch outline is unlikely - 240 x 180 mm is the target
stackup: HF ceramics, VIN+/SW/VOUT+ pours, device pads, film pads, HV terminals, mezzanine socket
commutation-loop dielectric (fabricator to confirm 0.20 mm between two 70 um layers; 0.25-0.30 mm acceptable if adjacency is kept)
PGND return pour under the commutation loop and bus; GND_CTRL pour under the SELV strip
gives 2.0 mm total with 4 x 70 um and 2 x 0.20 mm
Kelvin-source pours in the driver islands (shield), parallel VIN+/SW/VOUT+ pours, 12 V / 3V3 distribution in the SELV strip
gate pours with drivers, DESAT, rail decoupling and bias modules under the device row; parallel PGND/VOUT pours; SELV-strip parts
power_board.heatsink: Fischer Elektronik LAM 5 D K 100 12 (double-width LAM 5 profile, ~100 x 100 mm plan, 50 mm high, integrated 12 V fan, 0.30 K/W distributor figure - datasheet to confirm; CR-13); both TO-247-4 vertical against one face at 28 mm pitch, leads trimmed short; reserve 175 x 110 mm including fan, intake and exhaust corridors (corridors may hold parts <= 10 mm tall); PE-bonded; >= 5 mm HV copper keep-out; clip-to-lead >= 3 mm
placement_rules: commutation loop first: HF ceramics in columns beside the TO-247-4 legs, VIN+/PGND as overlapping pours on F.Cu/In1.Cu (<= 20 nH board target; 40-60 nH total with standing leads)
drivers and decoupling on B.Cu within 15 mm of the device leads; gate pour B.Cu over Kelvin pour In2.Cu
all barrier parts (3 x UCC14141, 2 x UCC21710, 2 x AMC1311, TMCS1133) on one straight barrier line; device row on the HV side of the driver islands; SELV strip at the board edge
film capacitors and inductor in the fan stream beside the sink, >= 10 mm from it; nothing heat-sensitive in the exhaust
HV terminals, relay-contact terminals and PTC at the input and output ends; PE stud M4
HS/LS inter-island copper-free barrier (KR-ISO-001 second clause): 3.0 mm outer / 1.0 mm inner between DRV_HS/DESAT_HS and DRV_LS/DESAT_LS nets
inductor >= 20 mm and film capacitors >= 20 mm from the heatsink body, films >= 15 mm from the inductor; intake/exhaust corridors hold only parts <= 15 mm tall

control_board.mounting: stacked ~11 mm above the SELV strip, overhanging the board edge by ~40 mm; no control-board copper above HV copper (air clearance >= 11 mm; the between-boards clearance argument is a standards review item); 4 x M3 standoffs

architecture.mechanical: open frame on a PE-bonded baseplate; power board on 6 x M4 x 15 mm standoffs; total height 15 + 2 + 55 = 72 mm (< 80 mm); mass about 1.8-2.0 kg (power-board copper 0.3-0.5 kg)

thermal.heatsink: Fischer Elektronik LAM 5 D K 100 12, R_th 0.30 K/W at nominal fan flow (unverified distributor figure; the exact ordering string and the 12 V fan airflow must be confirmed from the Fischer datasheet). Single-width LAM 5 K 100 12 (0.68 K/W) is the cost-down option only if measured R_pad <= 1 K/W. The TIDA-010054 Ohmite CR201-50VE (and clip CLA-TO-21E) is DISCONTINUED since August 2024 and is removed from the alternatives; its datasheet does carry a forced-convection curve, so the TI 0.5 C/W figure was plausibly a chart reading.
thermal.interface_pad: Bergquist Sil-Pad TSP A2000 0.254 mm (6 kVac class) custom cut 28 x 32 mm per device, no hole. Design R_pad 1.4 K/W: impedance 0.50 C-in2/W at ~25 psi clip pressure divided by the EXPOSED tab metal D1 x E1 ~ 17.0 x 13.6 mm = 2.3 cm2 = 0.36 in2 (the full 16 x 21 mm body outline used earlier gave an optimistic 0.96 K/W); 1.16 K/W if screw-mounted at 50 psi. TSP 3500 (4 kVac) would give 1.20 / 0.92 K/W. The pad voltage rating versus the impulse basis (2.5 kV OVC II vs 4 kV) is a preserved human-review conflict; the type test is defined by the isolation review.
thermal.hardware: LAM 5 K retaining clips (force to verify >= 40 N; clip pressure 17-26 psi); screw alternative only with a TO-247 insulating bushing whose shoulder covers the full 2.2-2.5 mm hole depth and is rated for the working voltage - the Boyd 7721-7PPSG (0.81 mm shoulder) is NOT adequate; pad overhang >= 5 mm beyond the tab; clip metal >= 3 mm from the leads

results.rth_jc_note: 0.41 K/W is a typical value with no datasheet maximum; 48.5 / 57.2 mohm at 150 C are interpolated/scaled

thermal.fan: integrated 12 V fan of the LAM 5 D K; current budgeted 0.5 A maximum (datasheet value unknown); at 10.8 V flow -10 % -> R_th +6 %

copper.method: IPC-2221 formula k = 0.048 / 0.024, exponents 0.44 / 0.725 (conservative relative to IPC-2152); via plating 25 um

other_components.inductor: 16-20 W typical / 23-26 W bounded; must sit in the fan stream (CR-14); >= 20 mm from the sink; films >= 20 mm from the sink and >= 15 mm from the inductor (thermal spacing adopted over the inductor record's 10 mm)
other_components.film_capacitors: >= 20 mm from the sink, outside the exhaust (recommendation, SKILL-006 step 3); hot-spot <= 85 C design

thermal.limitations: no CFD; equal-sharing lumped sink model (TI's factor 2 read as two devices per sink); distributor-level heatsink data; the 10 s overload treated as steady state (conservative)

standards_and_spacing.basis: IEC 62477-1 general (clause numbers secondary-source); IEC 61800-5-1:2007 tables as the numeric source (impulse 4 kV basic / 6 kV reinforced, 440 V DC working; the consulted copy is not on record, so values are tagged secondary until a licensed copy is reviewed); IEC 60664-1 Annex F origin (Tables F.1/F.2/F.4 corroborated); IEC 61800-5-1:2022 Ed. 3 + COR1:2023 renumbers the discharge clause to 4.4.9; IPC-2221B Table 6-1 functional spacing; IPC-2221 current capacity

kicad_rules_mm.to247_pin_field_exception: per-package rule derived from pad geometry (2.54 mm pitch cannot meet 3.0 mm); creepage review item

standards_and_spacing.slots: 1.2 mm nominal non-plated slots under every barrier part whose land gap g is < 9 mm (3 x UCC14141 DWN, 2 x UCC21710 DW, 2 x AMC1311 DWV, TMCS1133 DVG); each slot extends e >= 3 mm beyond the outermost pad edges so that the around-the-end surface path 2 x sqrt((g/2)^2 + e^2) >= 9.0 mm (the 'gap + 2 x board thickness' model is wrong for through-slots); the CGD1700HB2M-UNA 0.76 mm slot is not reusable at PD2
standards_and_spacing.between_boards: control-board copper never above HV copper; air clearance >= 11 mm between the stacked boards (standards review must confirm the through-air argument at PD2)
standards_and_spacing.discharge: < 60 V within 60 s with IEC 60417-5036 label + time and DC-LINK LIVE LEDs per bank; 5 s passive option (~4.5 W) documented
standards_and_spacing.pe: PE conductor cross-section >= supply conductor; bonding resistance <= 0.1 ohm; Y2 touch-current estimate (0.85-1.8 mA at 50 kHz) excludes mains-frequency ripple of a rectifier-derived bus

conflict_resolutions.decision: direct SELV NTC (Vishay NTCALUG01A103F, 1500 Vac lug insulation) to the control board; the heatsink is PE-bonded and SGND is PE-bonded at one point (proposed PELV deviation), so the lug potential equals the control reference. The CB-PR-002 path through the LS driver AIN would place the floating PGND-to-PE voltage across the NTC and is recorded as adapted-then-rejected for this grounding scheme; CB-PR-002 stays a fallback only. Both driver AIN pins tied to COM.

all 12 V loads behind the eFuse; R_ILIM 6.04 k -> circuit-breaker threshold about 1.96 A; worst-case 1.76 A during relay pull-in, 1.59 A steady with the mandatory PWM coil hold; external supply 2.5 A recommended; fan-upstream fallback documented.

capacitor agent's 2512 chains adopted; indicator strings 3 x 150 k (input) and 2 x 100 k (output) 1206 + LED (the sensing agent's 2 x 220 k 1206 string exceeded the 200 V / 0.25 W element limits); ~30 s coupled discharge under the 60 s + label criterion; 5 s option documented.
230 V (15 %); divider 953 ohm / 10.0 k; a 25 A load dump (215-218 V) stays below the trip.
worst-case trip corner ~42.6 A (L 175 uH) versus soft roll-off (L(41 A) >= 175 uH worst, B 0.80 T = 53 % of B_sat): acceptable, no hard knee; recorded for review.

Fischer LAM 5 D K 100 12 (double width, 0.30 K/W) replaces both the architecture reservation (100 x 40 x 50) and the thermal agent's single-width choice; NTC moves to the sink top face beside the HS footprint; device pitch stays 28 mm for the commutation loop.
program 300 ns (45 ticks) at bring-up for an effective >= 265 ns after skew erosion; target 250 ns; tune toward 200 ns by double-pulse test.
Vishay NTCALUG01A103F (fetched datasheet) instead of TDK B57703M0103G040 (whose lead length and 1000 Vac/1 s test voltage were also misquoted).
standards agent's 3.0 mm outer / 1.0 mm inner replaces the capacitor agent's provisional 2.5 / 1.5 mm (4 kV impulse basis).
Wuerth REDCUBE THR M5 74651195 for VIN+, PGND_IN, VOUT+, PGND_OUT and the two relay-contact terminals (ring lugs under IPXXB covers off-board); M4 PE stud pad.
2-pin probe-loop test points at the device side of R_G instead of MMCX jacks.

dedicated third UCC14141-Q1 configured VDD-VEE 15 V / COM-VEE 5.0 V with VEE = PGND; the AMC1311s run from COM (sourcing direction of the COM regulator). The shared LS-gate-module + TLV76050 pattern (TIDA-010054 decision 7, CB-IS-002) fails the COM-VEE regulator sink check (RLIM would need <= ~100 ohm, outside the RLIM qualification) and the KR-IS-004 sharing review; it remains the documented alternative. RECOM R12P2 / Murata MGJ2 modules are basic-insulation parts (250 Vrms working) and are not acceptable for the HV-SELV barrier.

Sil-Pad TSP A2000 (6 kVac) baseline for dielectric margin against the 4 kV impulse view; TSP 3500 alternative after an assembled-pad type test; pad voltage rating vs impulse category kept as a human-review conflict.
inductor placed in the fan stream (forced air mandatory; 110-120 C hot spot predicted in still air); 3-stack core fallback if the thermocouple acceptance (<= 110 C) fails.
KLKD025.T (25 A) instead of 20 A: 88 % loading at the 320 V stop corner with 27.5 A and 50-60 C ambient derating ruled out the 20 A member; I2t coordination open.

OPA2320 difference stages, REF3125 and the TMCS1133 V_OC divider move to the power-board SELV strip so that only single-ended, ground-referenced VIN_SENSE / VOUT_SENSE / ISENSE / ISENSE_REF cross the mezzanine (the AMC1311 differential pairs otherwise lacked connector pins).

controller agent's SN74LV21A AND-gate combiner owns the fault bus; latched group vs run-permit group defined (UVLO and RDY are run permits with auto-restart); ARM clocks the latch; the sensing agent's wired-OR node is dropped.
TPS26400 MODE open = circuit breaker (I_CB = 12/R_ILIM - 0.03 A, 4 ms, 540 ms retry) is the sizing basis; TPS3808G01 top resistor 101 k for the 4.5 V threshold.

SN74LVC1G74DCTR (SSOP-8) replaces the non-existent DCKR; MOV S20K385 = B72220S0381K101; PTC to be re-selected (quoted code/parameter mismatch); relay freewheel diode >= 1 A; UCC14141 input capacitors 3 x 10 uF.
input current limited to 15.6 A below 360 V (A-02 / A-05 inconsistency at the 320 V stop corner); source current limit 18-25 A.

conflict_resolutions.topic: insulating pad resistance and mounting hardware
conflict_resolutions.decision: R_pad re-based on the exposed tab metal (2.3 cm2): TSP A2000 1.4 K/W clip / 1.16 K/W screw; T_J,HS up to ~130 C at the 360 V / 27.5 A max-R corner on the LAM 5 D K sink (P_max 41.5 W, margin 1.22); screw mounting only with a full-depth TO-247 insulating bushing (Boyd 7721-7PPSG rejected).
HV area 33,600 mm2 at 73 % utilisation (not 28,800 / 86 %); core 1.32 mm for the 2.0 mm stack; 240 x 180 mm is the target outline.
inductor and films >= 20 mm from the sink, films >= 15 mm from the inductor; HS/LS inter-island barrier 3.0 / 1.0 mm added to the placement rules.
Ohmite CR201-50VE / CLA-TO-21E removed (discontinued Aug 2024); knowledge-base feedback item.

open_items_for_human_review: C4MS025120K availability (Arrow stock only, 13-week lead) and unpublished short-circuit withstand time; Gen-4 750 V family check
Fischer LAM 5 D K 100 12 datasheet (R_th, airflow, fan current, mass) not accessible; all figures distributor-level; Samtec stack height unverified
UCC14141-Q1 RLIM values, SOA at 10.8 V / 19 V, isolation certificate status; feasibility of the COM-VEE 5.0 V sensing configuration
TDK CGA9P 2220 DC-bias curve and lifecycle unverified; count may need to rise or the 1 kV Knowles part substituted

Insulation coordination: 4 kV vs 2.5 kV impulse basis; 9.0 mm all-layer HV-to-SELV rule vs standard minimum 5.5 mm; slots under isolators; stacked-board air clearance; pad voltage rating; relay coil-to-contact insulation; standards values not read from a licensed copy
SGND-to-PE bond (PELV) is a proposed deviation from the SELV seed; PGND floating vs bonded; Y-capacitor use
Precharge: PTC re-selection, relay never opening under load (400 V maximum switching voltage), fuse I2t not found, source current limit 18-25 A required
Custom inductor winding house, core orderable code (0058192A2 vs C058192A2), potting cup part number, acoustic noise, worst-case core loss
Efficiency budget: MOSFET 47-57 W + inductor 16-26 W + driver E_on penalty 2-4 W + copper ~3 W + aux ~8 W + ring ~1 W = 77-99 W (98.0-98.5 %) typical, no margin at the bounded worst case
All distributor-only parameters (Samtec, G9EA-1 variants, KLKD I2t, SMBJ15CA, AO3400A, US1M lifecycle, BAT42W) to be confirmed from manufacturer datasheets

Knowledge-base maintenance: CMP-TMCS1133 orderable variants; stale cache paths in three component records; SKILL-006 TI instance values unsupported by datasheets; C3M0030090K obsolete; CB-PR-002 APWM polarity (88 % at 0.6 V, 10 % at 4.5 V); PE-PCB-* rules not retrievable through query.py; query.py console encoding

Pad resistance (1.4 K/W design) rests on the exposed-tab area read from the package table; measure the case-to-sink drop on the first assembly; the 125 C preference is not met at the hottest max-R corner

Signalling across the mezzanine is single-ended by adaptation of the KR-GD-008 exclusion (stacked boards, <= 100 mm segment); the assumptions and gate-driver records asked for RS-422 (CB-GD-003) when boards are separated - documented deviation for review
